from subject import (
    CRITICAL_ENV_VARS,
    ModelEnvHealthResult,
    check_critical_env_vars,
)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_healthy_when_all_critical_vars_set(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL", "https://omniintelligence.local")
    monkeypatch.setenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", "kafka:9092")
    result = check_critical_env_vars()
    assert isinstance(result, ModelEnvHealthResult)
    assert result.healthy is True
    assert result.warnings == []


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_warning_when_var_missing(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", "kafka:9092")
    result = check_critical_env_vars()
    assert result.healthy is False
    assert len(result.warnings) == 1
    assert "INTELLIGENCE_SERVICE_URL" in result.warnings[0]
    assert "KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" not in result.warnings[0]

@pytest.mark.unit
def test_warning_messages_include_impact(monkeypatch):

    monkeypatch.delenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS", raising=False)
